completePrimary.limits: Render submission intervals, not physical presents. Complete window includes first use; warm is supplemental. 1% low uses the mean of the slowest ceil(N*.01) intervals, not reciprocal P99.

limitations: GPU pixel-equivalence oracle only, no FPS or GPU utilization claim.
Working framebuffer/reflection/postprocess targets are overwritten; a fresh normal render is requested after restoration.
Material versions/program cache dirtiness are never rolled back. GL error flags are consumed/reported and cannot be requeued.

Controlled QA only: game/camera/material/uniform/RT/viewport/scissor/clear controls are restored. Raw GL bindings are deliberately not byte-exact restored; native renderer.resetState invalidates caches and the next native draw rebuilds them. No third-party draws may interleave.
